subject: URGENT: In-flight request sanitization patch — immediate customer coordination
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: eng-oncall@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-23T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: [ACTION] Short-notice patch for in-flight request sanitization regression

Team —

We just received a reproducible report that certain in-flight requests with embedded metadata are bypassing our request sanitizer under heavy concurrency. This can cause downstream tokenization exceptions and, in the worst case, malformed KV cache keys for affected sessions.

Summary: 
- Severity: P2 -> trending toward P1 for a small subset of sessions (confirmed by BluePeak).
- Impact: ~0.6% of inference requests from long-lived sessions (sampled across regions) may see errors or unexpected output. No persistent data exposure identified, but malformed payloads can cause degraded quality.
- Root cause (early): race condition in the sanitization step when concurrent header-normalization and prefix-caching occur.

We have a working hotfix (sanitization-patch-rc1) that serializes the small critical section and adds a conservative validation gate. Engineering intends to deploy a short-notice, rolling hotfix to hosted clusters in 60 minutes to stop new occurrences.

Immediate asks:
- Rishi / Karthik: validate RC on stage and produce a smoke checklist (tokenization + KV cache validation).
- Grace: coordinate rollout windows by region and prepare tracing flags for a 2-hour observation window.
- Monica: prep a brief customer advisory and coordinate direct outreach to BluePeak.

Attachments: sanitization-patch-rc1.tar.gz (binary) and impact-matrix-bluepeak.xlsx (spreadsheet).

I'll draft a customer-facing advisory once smoke checks are green. Stand by for timeline update in ~30 minutes.

— Marissa
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Katie Nguyen <katie.nguyen@bluepeak.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@bluepeak.ai, cloudops@cloudinfra.com
Date: 2027-05-23T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [ACTION] Short-notice patch for in-flight request sanitization regression

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the heads-up. BluePeak is seeing intermittent failures on our production pipelines that align with your description — primarily long-running sessions used for batch enrichment. We appreciate the rapid response.

Questions for planning:
1) Will the hotfix require session restarts or client-side changes?
2) What's the expected outage window (if any) per region?
3) Can you provide a simple verification step we can run post-deploy to confirm we're back to normal?

We have a limited maintenance window between 10:15–11:15 PDT today. If you can aim for the start of that window it helps us avoid backlog.

—Katie
Head of Platform Engineering, BluePeak Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Nguyen <katie.nguyen@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, cloudops@cloudinfra.com
Date: 2027-05-23T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [ACTION] Short-notice patch for in-flight request sanitization regression

Katie —

Thanks for flagging your maintenance window. Short answers up front:
1) Client changes: none required. The hotfix is server-side and backward compatible. No client-side restarts needed; however, any active long-lived sessions may experience transient errors during the brief window and should be retried by client logic (idempotent).
2) Outage window: we expect a rolling, near-zero downtime deployment. Each shard will see a 5–15s warmup on first request after the patch; we will route traffic away and drain in-flight requests where possible. Overall customer-visible disruption should be minimal but we cannot fully rule out transient failures for affected session types.
3) Verification step (simple): run a handful of your long-running session requests (preferably with the same session ids) and confirm:
   - No tokenization exceptions in the response headers
   - Consistent KV cache key patterns (we will share a small tool to sample keys)

Planned timeline (tentative):
- 09:30 PDT: Final RC validation in staging.
- 09:50 PDT: Begin rolling release in us-west clusters (shard-by-shard, 5 min per shard).
- 10:20 PDT: us-west complete, begin us-east.

Because your window starts 10:15, we will prioritize BluePeak's traffic in the first wave and aim to finish the us-west rollout by ~10:10–10:20. We'll provide a post-deploy verification checklist and a tracing snippet you can run.

Attachment: quick-verify.sh (inline snippet) — I'll share the script and the sample KV-key-sampler immediately after deployment.

If anything shifts we'll notify you via this thread and we can pause the rollout.

— Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-23T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [ACTION] Short-notice patch for in-flight request sanitization regression — post-deploy notes

Patch was deployed to us-west as planned and prioritized for BluePeak traffic. Quick summary: 
- Rollout: completed shard-by-shard, no rollbacks.
- Observed: a brief spike in 5xxs on first warmed requests (5–12s), then stable. BluePeak reported one client retry that succeeded.
- Mitigation: tracing flags enabled; we flagged and backfilled KV-key-samples for the affected sessions.

Next steps (postmortem / follow-up):
- We'll open INC-5421 and include a timeline and the root-cause analysis (race in header-normalization).
- Recommend a follow-up patch to remove the conservative gate after we add a more targeted lock-free validation (tracked as ENG-9932).
- Customer comms: Monica — please send a short post-deploy summary to BluePeak with the verification script and an optional conference call slot tomorrow.

Copy of deploy log snippet attached: deploy-log-usw-20270523.txt (attachment).

— Rishi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
